## 简体中文

- 将“CN 前置分流”更名为“CN 路由分流”，明确区分真实目标 IP 的系统路由与前置 DNS 的域名分流。启用 CN 路由不再关闭 FakeIP；真实大陆 IP 可经物理网卡直连，其他公网 IP 和 FakeIP 流量进入核心。
- 限定 CN 代理规则只处理 TUN 收到的真实 IP 流量，避免按境外域名解析出的国内 CDN 地址覆盖 FakeIP 域名分流，并保留无原生 IPv6 默认路由时的 FakeIP 接管能力。
- 修复编辑自定义域名后内置 domains-min 规则从前置 DNS 热更新配置中丢失的问题。统一初始化与更新的域名规则组装，并使前置直连由真实 IP 应答而非核心直连规则实现。
- 补全域名分流和 CN 路由的核心出口快捷选择，支持核心直连、可用节点、可路由端点及有效策略组；改用可搜索的选择控件，区分前置直连与核心直连，并核对核心返回的实际选择。

## English

- Rename CN pre-routing to CN routing and distinguish destination-IP system routes from frontend DNS domain policies. Enabling CN routing no longer disables FakeIP: real mainland China IPs can use the physical uplink, while other public IPs and FakeIP traffic enter the core.
- Limit the CN proxy rule to real-IP traffic received by TUN, so a foreign domain's mainland CDN address cannot override its FakeIP domain routing. Preserve FakeIP capture without a native IPv6 default route.
- Fix bundled domains-min rules disappearing from the DNS frontend after custom-domain hot updates. Share rule assembly between initialization and updates, and implement frontend direct access through real-IP answers instead of core direct rules.
- Complete quick core-outbound choices with direct access, available nodes, routable endpoints, and valid policy groups. Use searchable selectors, distinguish frontend direct access from core direct access, and verify the selection returned by the core.
